description: §5.2 rule 2, S457 bullet SVG animation values: `<set attributeName="href" to="javascript:${@u}">` interpolates data after a literal executable scheme into a value that animates a link's href — refused.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457): on `<set>` / `<animate>` / …, the value attributes `to` / `from` / `by` / `values` are URL-valued attributes for rule 2 "when `attributeName` is written as a static string naming an attribute of the URL-valued list"; a literal scheme other than the safe set before `${…}` SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE). Chromium runs the animated `javascript:` href on click (g-svg-animation-and-meta-refresh-url-sinks-s456).
